tagline: Display, lighting and keymap for your Chilkey ND104
welcome.update_text: Your settings and API keys are kept.
welcome.reinstall: ND104 Studio {version} is already installed. Install it again to repair it.
welcome.downgrade: ND104 Studio {from} is installed – this setup contains the older version {to}. Your settings are kept, but older versions may not know newer options.
welcome.msi: ND104 Studio is also installed for all users (MSI). Remove one of them in Windows "Apps" so it does not run twice.
welcome.no_payload: This setup was built without ND104 Studio and cannot install it.
disclaimer: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with Chilkey. By installing you accept the {license}.
uninstall.title: Uninstall ND104 Studio {version}?
uninstall.text: The app, its shortcuts and the autostart entry are removed.
uninstall.keep_hint: Unticked, the settings, stored API keys and logs are deleted as well.
done.updated: ND104 Studio is up to date.
done.updated_text: ND104 Studio {version} is running again – see the tray icon.
done.uninstalled_kept: Your settings were kept for a later installation.
done.tray: ND104 Studio runs in the system tray, next to the clock.
hint.keyboard: No keyboard connected – connect it with the USB cable or via Bluetooth.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.install: ND104 Studio could not be installed. Your previous installation was left unchanged.
error.uninstall: ND104 Studio could not be removed completely. Close ND104 Studio and try again.
webview2.title: ND104 Studio Setup
webview2.question:
ND104 Studio needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is missing on this PC.

Download and install it from Microsoft now?
webview2.failed: The WebView2 Runtime could not be installed. Please install it from microsoft.com and run the setup again.
